If multiple minions controlled by the same Methuselah play a Poison Pill,
and the referendum passes, is the effect multiplied?
(Con Agg, terms are 4 on prey, prey has played 2 poison pills from different
minions, does predator burn 8 pool?)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> If multiple minions controlled by the same Methuselah play a Poison Pill,
> and the referendum passes, is the effect multiplied?

The effects stack (added is a better term than multiplied, here, I think).

> (Con Agg, terms are 4 on prey, prey has played 2 poison pills from different
> minions, does predator burn 8 pool?)

Yes, if the referendum passes.
